metadata.title: Dow drops 165 points on losses in NVIDIA Corp., Cisco shares - MarketWatch

content.text:
Dow Update
Dow drops 165 points on losses in NVIDIA Corp., Cisco shares
Behind negative returns for shares of NVIDIA Corp. and Cisco, the Dow Jones Industrial Average is trading down Thursday morning.
The Dow Dow Jones Industrial Average was most recently trading 165 points lower (-0.3%), as shares of NVIDIA Corp. NVIDIA Corp. and Cisco Cisco Systems Inc. are contributing to the index's intraday decline.
